title: Hakuichi Gold Leaf Chopstick Gift Set
description_en: Hand-lacquered chopsticks adorned with genuine 24K gold leaf — a craft of Kanazawa, Japan's gold leaf capital. Each pair is unique. Presented in an elegant paulownia wood box, ideal as a gift.
description_ja: 金沢・箔一の純金箔を纏わせた本漆塗り箸。24K純金箔を手作業で施した一点物。桐箱入りで贈り物に最適。金沢の伝統工芸を食卓に。
